title: Nanit Sleep Improvement After Hatch Routine
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nanit:sleep
| search hatch_completed=* sleep_score=*
| stats avg(sleep_score) as avg_sleep_score avg(total_sleep_min) as avg_sleep_min by hatch_completed
| sort hatch_completed
description: Examines sleep quality after completed Hatch routines.
value: Comparing sleep quality with and without the routine shows whether the effort is earning its place.
implementation: Send sleep quality after completed Hatch routines events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of sleep quality after completed Hatch routines, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates what is happening with sleep quality after completed Hatch routines, so odd changes stand out quickly.
